title: Every field a student meets is checked
statement: Make sure every field a student sees or hears is read by at least one check.
example: Three clips played as silence behind a passing build because no check looked for them.
detail: In one course nothing validated the lesson-page video checkpoints and nothing checked that voice-over clips existed, and three clips played as silence behind a green build until both checks were added (`grade3-reading/artifacts/DECISIONS-2026-08-24.md`). Review clips carried no hash of the text they voice, so a definition edit left a clip silently stale (`grade3-reading/artifacts/l4-p3-stale-clip-2026-09-29/README.md`), and the audit script never read the search fields at all, the direct root cause of a leak in those fields that no machine caught (`grade3-reading/artifacts/feedback-inceptbench-2026-09-30/REGISTER.md`).

evidence.quote: video checkpoints were validated by nothing (only unit videos were walked),
clips were never checked for existence — three played as silence
Class gap: frame `rows[].audio_path` review clips have no `audio_of`, so a definition edit leaves the clip silently stale.
The audit script (audit.py) never reads think_aloud.states[].search / we_do.search fields at all

**Rule.** R-COPY-1 and R-COPY-2 apply to every word a child reads, including the praise and the hint composed at answer time by the scorer. Those two are rewritten into house style in `src/app/api/speak-score/route.ts` before they are returned, because no validator can see a line that does not exist until the child answers.
so half the words in a conversation were exempt from the rules the other half were checked against, and a model reaches for an em-dash by default.
By `houseStyle()` in the scoring route, on every reply before it is sent. Not by a validator, which cannot reach runtime text.
